title: Origin story: Pele
description: Pele is the goddess of volcanoes and fire, who traveled down the Hawaiian island chain seeking a home, digging fire-pits until she settled at Kilauea. Her rages build new land; her calm lets forests grow. She appears as a beautiful woman or an old crone, and her hair — fine volcanic glass — drifts on the wind.
